# dislop

> A red pen for AI-written drafts, decks, and web pages. Strikes what can't ship, asks about what sounds canned, and checks edits against the original so numbers, qualifiers, dates, links, code spans, and citations stay put. Zero runtime dependencies; works offline in Node.js 20+, Python 3.10+, MCP, or a browser tab.

Choose the page that matches the file you are reviewing. Each guide names the checks to run and shows an example edit. Use the local CLI or MCP server to check a file or compare a revision.

## Start by task (~800-1,500 tokens each)
- [Review a brief or proposal](https://dislop.com/tasks/business-doc.md): Core errors, `business-brief` rules, and edit comparison.
- [Check a web page or slide deck](https://dislop.com/tasks/web-and-deck.md): Contrast, dark-mode elevation, `deck-and-ui` rules, and design tokens.
- [Edit an essay](https://dislop.com/tasks/editorial-writing.md): `literary-essay` rules, contrasts, and voice notes.
- [Check files before release](https://dislop.com/tasks/pre-release-gate.md): Core `error` checks, git diff CI gating, and `verify`.

## Browse by topic
- [Methodology & Brand Guide](https://dislop.com/methodology/index.md): Deletion Test, anti-pattern notes, brand voice guide, and visual tokens.
- [Examples & References](https://dislop.com/cases/index.md): Before / overcorrected / after contrasts and 31 print/type design references.
- [Install & Integrations](https://dislop.com/tools/index.md): Browser workbench, `SKILL.md`, CLI (`npx`/`uvx`), MCP server, and CI hooks.
- [Awesome Anti-Slop](https://dislop.com/awesome/index.md): 87 checked tools, guides, and papers (`dislop.radar/2`, raw JSON at `/awesome/index.json`).
- [Roadmap & Open Questions](https://dislop.com/roadmap.md): Active tracks (`v0.2.x` -> `v0.4+`) and collaboration guide.

## Machine index & packs
- [JSON Catalog](https://dislop.com/catalog.json): Versioned manifest (`dislop.catalog/1`) with sha256 and token estimates.
- [Agent Skill](https://dislop.com/tools/skill.md): `check -> edit -> verify` workflow instructions.
- [Rule Packs](https://dislop.com/packs/core.md): Also `/packs/business-brief.md`, `/packs/literary-essay.md`, `/packs/deck-and-ui.md`, and 29 `/rules/<id>.md` cards.
- [Single-Fetch Bundle](https://dislop.com/llms-full.txt): All 29 rules compiled without test fixtures.
